conventions.images: RGB in [0,1] after the policy's own image preprocessing (LIBERO cameras are 256x256; rotate as the policy expects before perturbing)
conventions.level: severity levels are listed from mild to strong; 'harmless_levels' are expected not to change success
conventions.implementation: observation = transform the observation dict only; instruction = replace the text; simulator = change the MuJoCo/LIBERO scene, render, then read the observation
conventions.label_preserving: true if the demonstrated actions remain correct under the perturbation, so a supervisor can learn it by augmenting the existing demonstrations
conventions.experiments: E1 = scored starting observations; E2 = within-task referral (label-preserving families only); E3 = events during rollouts

families.name: graded paraphrase
families.implementation: instruction
families.source: scripts/calibration/language_variation_prompts.json (released with Römer et al.; index 0 = original P1)
families.supervisor_augmentation: sample P1-P5 uniformly per training sample

families.name: object synonym
families.implementation: instruction
families.notes: defaults only; replace the first listed object for the one-word level; keep grammar correct
families.supervisor_augmentation: random subset of the synonym table per sample

families.name: surface variation
families.implementation: instruction
levels: one typo in a non-object word
harmless_levels: one typo in a non-object word

families.name: underspecified
families.implementation: instruction
levels: object nouns replaced by pronouns ('put it in the basket')
families.notes: ambiguous rather than unfamiliar; E1 only

families.name: blatant
families.implementation: instruction

families.name: lighting change
families.implementation: simulator (scale MuJoCo light diffuse/specular; rotate light direction; tint colour); image-space fallback: brightness/gamma/channel gains
families.supervisor_augmentation: colour jitter: brightness 0.4-2.0, contrast 0.7-1.3, per-channel gain 0.75-1.1

families.name: sensor degradation
families.implementation: observation
families.supervisor_augmentation: Gaussian noise sigma 0-0.1, random blur, random JPEG 10-90

families.name: camera pose shift ('bumped camera')
families.implementation: simulator (move agentview camera: translation in random direction + rotation about random axis); image-space fallback: affine shift/rotation
families.supervisor_augmentation: random affine: shift up to 12 px, rotation up to 8 deg, scale 0.95-1.05 (workspace camera)

families.name: target partly occluded
families.implementation: observation: table-coloured rectangle over the projected bounding box of the target object (project the body position with the camera matrix); simulator variant for E3: an occluding object
families.supervisor_augmentation: random cutouts of 5-30% of the image side (random positions, table colour or grey), p=0.3
families.notes: lerobot.envs ImagePatchOODConfig gives random (not target-centred) patches and can be adapted

families.name: texture or colour change
families.implementation: simulator (swap table/floor texture; shift target geom_rgba hue)
families.supervisor_augmentation: not exactly augmentable (object-specific colour); E1/E3 only

families.name: wrist camera fault
families.implementation: observation
levels: frozen frame (E3: repeat the frame at onset)
families.supervisor_augmentation: blank the wrist image with p=0.1

families.name: blatant image corruption
families.implementation: observation

families.name: target displaced outside its training region
families.implementation: simulator (shift the target's free joint before the first observation, collision-free); alternative: released OOD layouts (lerobot.envs BddlSwapOODConfig)

families.name: extra distractor
families.implementation: simulator (add an object from another LIBERO scene via BDDL, or move an existing non-target object)

families.name: target rotated
families.implementation: simulator (rotate the target about the vertical axis)

families.name: objects vanish or scrambled
families.implementation: simulator (existing capture events vanish-target, vanish-all, scramble)

families.name: initial joint offset (robot not at home pose)
families.implementation: simulator (add the offset with random signs to the 7 arm joints before the first observation)

families.name: proprioception bias
families.implementation: observation (add a constant offset to the end-effector position in the state vector, random direction)
families.supervisor_augmentation: constant per-episode offset of the state position, N(0, 3 cm) per axis

families.name: push during execution
families.implementation: simulator (add 0.1 rad to the arm joints once, or apply an external force for 10 steps)

families.name: other task's instruction in the same scene
families.implementation: instruction
levels: other scene: an instruction naming objects that are absent
families.notes: E3: the user switches the instruction mid-episode; detection only, success is not comparable

families.name: views from different starting states
families.implementation: observation (workspace image from state i, wrist image from state j of the same task)

families.name: state from a different starting state
families.implementation: observation

families.name: invisible mass or friction change
families.implementation: simulator (scale target body mass / geom friction)
